This section covers what the desk expects

Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures
This section explains how staff support travelers with animals, protect welfare, and keep records clear from booking through arrival.

Desk staff must greet each traveler with calm attention, review the carrier and documents with care, and give plain guidance before departure. Animals are handled with gentle methods only, with no loud correction, rough contact, or rushed movement. If a crate, harness, or other carrier appears damaged, the desk should note it and arrange a safer option when possible. Staff should also confirm the traveler understands where the animal will be accepted, how it will be screened, and what items may remain with the pet.

When a crate is delayed, lost, or misrouted, the desk records the report, supports the traveler with a respectful update, and keeps the case open until the follow-up is complete. <<FACT F118>> Staff should remain steady and helpful, even when the traveler is worried. If a missed connection affects the animal journey, the desk documents the disruption, explains the next step in simple language, and routes the case for review. <<FACT F110>> No promise should be made beyond the authority of the desk, and all notes must stay factual, brief, and complete.

The desk also reminds travelers to keep the pet calm, hydrated, and secure as directed by ground staff, and to report any concern right away. Any sign of distress, injury, or unsafe containment must be escalated without delay so the animal can receive prompt attention.

For questions or exceptions, contact the senior coordinator on carrier checks or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways.
